name: splendor
description: Unofficial open-source implementation of the board game Splendor for boardgamers.space (engine + viewer)

scripts.build: pnpm --filter splendor-engine build && pnpm --filter splendor-viewer build
scripts.tsc: pnpm --filter splendor-engine tsc && pnpm --filter splendor-viewer tsc
scripts.check: pnpm fmt:check && pnpm lint && pnpm tsc && pnpm test && pnpm build
